requirements: R1: Clear or retry the 5 failed tasks to resolve the BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state and unblock Flow Core.

slices.title: Patch Flow Core to clear failed tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery patch for this epic, I want to clear or retry the failed tasks, so that the Flow Core resumes active work.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the Flow Core is in a BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state with 5 failed tasks
When the unblock patch is applied
Then the failed tasks are cleared
And tests confirm the Flow Core resumes active work
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failed tasks blocking the Flow Core from 5 to 0
